description: Use to set or replace the project webhook URL. Available on free and yearly. A signing secret is generated once if the project has none. Forms inherit this unless webhook_url_override is set. Do not use this for a one-off delivery — call test_webhook.

project_id.description: Project (website) id from list_projects, create_project, or bootstrap_site.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for X-Furrow-Signature. Omit to have one generated and returned.

webhook_url.description: Public https endpoint that receives a signed JSON POST per clean submission. Null disables it.

name: upsert_project_webhook
title: Upsert project webhook
